note: Set pieces as verb lists (ruled 2026-10-15). spec/bosses.md explains every row. Arenas are packet G's (ids by reference). Damage amounts are 1.7's: a bare roll is unscaled, a scaled roll with number-scale and lethality is 1.7's sDMG. Move clocks are 1.7's (actor-action: the boss's own actions; action: player actions); bosses.md question 1 proposes game turns for all.

deep-maw.name: The Deep Maw

arena.mounds: 2x2 burrow mounds, closed until the Maw comes up through one

deep-maw.hearing: feels tremors: any loud player action, or a move that is not levitating, inside the arena tells it where the player is (spec/monsters.md B2)

states.plan: pick the eruption site: a 3x3 on the last sighting or tremor (any of the 2x2 body spots that fit), except on the first eruption and every third eruption while above half HP, which pick a burrow mound (the first eruption: the mound nearest the last sighting; later: a random mound) and mark the walkable ring round it. Below half HP an eruption on the player also marks the ring round the nearest mound as rubble.

body.parts: mawlimb on the other three tiles pass every hit to the Maw; one hit per action reaches the body however many tiles it covers

arena.circles: 2x2 ritual circles; fallback: the boss room, or the largest room, with no circles

arena.nodeRule: each node on ground the player can walk to, 3+ tiles from the body; one fewer for each that cannot be placed

body.parts: heartlimb bodies on the other three tiles pass every hit to the Heart (ruled 2026-10-16)

arena.pool: a lava lake in the far half of the central chamber

unmaker.name: The Unmaker
unmaker.formChange: the body keeps its place and HP; damage pair, armour, speed, name and look switch to the new form's row; any pending warning is dropped; the next big move waits 2 game turns; summons are ready at once

effects.placement: within 4 of the boss and 2+ from the boss and the player, nearest the player

rewards.victory: the true Forge wakes: standing beside it offers Retire (victory) or Keep exploring (packet H)

tiles.toward: nearest party member the boss can see
